items.title: General Public Comment
Report of the General Manager
Bay Area Water Supply and Conservation Agency Report
CONSENT CALENDAR

Approve the novation of Contract No. PUC-0002.D Master As-Needed Security System Maintenance and Integration Services from RFI Enterprises, Inc., DBA RFI Communications and Security Systems, to Pavion Corp

Award Contract No. WW-730, Various Locations Sewer Replacement No. 18 to A. Ruiz Construction Co. & Associates, Inc., in the amount of $7,745,522 and with a duration of 480 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and four months), to replace/line/mortar existing sewers on specified streets in the City and County of San Francisco. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action

Award Contract No. WW-768, As-A Sewer Inspection (FY25) to the sole, responsible bidder that submitted a responsive bid, Pipe and Plant Solutions, Inc., in the amount of $3,289,175 with a duration of 380 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and one month), selected in accordance with San Francisco Administrative Code section 6.23(c)(2), to inspect existing sewers on an as-needed basis, at locations to be determined by Wastewater Enterprise throughout the City and County of San Francisco

Approve Amendment No. 1 to Contract No. PRO.0112, As-Needed Factory Inspection and Surveillance Services, with Bureau Veritas North America, Inc., increasing the contract duration by two years for a total contract duration of seven years, with no change to the contract amount, to continue providing inspection, testing, and surveillance services for the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission in support of capital improvement projects

Approve an increase of $3,100,000 to the cost contingency and an increase of 260 calendar days to the duration contingency for Contract No. PW-011, Bay Corridor Transmission and Distribution Phase 4 and Water Improvements, with Mitchell Engineering, for a revised cost limit of $20,118,385 and a revised duration limit of 931 consecutive calendar days, to extend water mains and upsize service pipes prior to a future paving contract; install remote control and monitoring facilities; and SFPUC JUNE 24, 2025 MINUTES Page 3 of 7 remove an abandoned Pacific Gas and Electric Company gas pipeline
Approve updates to the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission’s existing commercial clothes washer rebate program
items.text: Approve updates to the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission’s existing commercial clothes washer rebate program to reduce the rebate from $5,000 per qualifying commercial-grade clothes washing machine to $1,000; remove the 10-dwelling unit or more eligibility requirement for multi-family properties to allow any size multi-family properties to participate for washers installed in common-area laundry rooms; and clarify several minor program terms

items.title: Approve an increase of $1,500,000 to the cost contingency and an increase of 266 calendar days to the duration contingency for Contract No. HH-1013, Moccasin Compound Water System Filtration
items.text: Approve an increase of $1,500,000 to the cost contingency and an increase of 266 calendar days to the duration contingency for Contract No. HH-1013, Moccasin Compound Water System Filtration Addition, with Sierra Mountain Construction, Inc., for a revised cost limit of $6,095,729, and a revised duration limit of 646 calendar days (approximately one year and nine months), for additional costs and schedule impacts related to a revised building foundation system due to unforeseen, differing site conditions

items.title: Accept work performed by JDB and Sons Construction, Inc - Contract No. WW-704, Various Locations Sewer Replacement No. 9; approve Modification No. 4
items.text: Accept work performed by JDB and Sons Construction, Inc., under Contract No. WW- 704, Various Locations Sewer Replacement No. 9; approve Modification No. 4 (Final) decreasing the contract amount by $10,750 for a total contract amount of $3,637,491 and increasing the contract duration by 11 calendar days for a total contract duration of 785 consecutive calendar days (approximately two years and three months), to adjust the final SFPUC JUNE 24, 2025 MINUTES Page 4 of 7 contract amount to the value of actual contract quantities completed and adjust the final contract duration to complete pavement restoration work scope; and authorize final payment to the contractor

items.title: Approve an increase to CleanPowerSF’s payment with the California Community Power Authority from $4,772,710 to a total not to exceed amount of $8,286,095
items.text: Approve an increase to CleanPowerSF’s payment of its share of on-going general and administrative costs under its agreement with the California Community Power Authority from $4,772,710 to a total not to exceed amount of $8,286,095, for a period of 23 years, and authorize the General Manager to seek Board of Supervisors approval
